source: Rules & Game Spec v2.0 Part B (transcribed verbatim), Pre-Build Q&A 22 Nov 2026 confirmations. Extra cards (source: art) transcribed from the printed PSD card faces and disabled by default.

cards.name: Dark Shredder
cards.text: You may roll red die. Even: +1 Physical. Odd: -1 Physical.
cards.implementation: Optional, chosen before rolling in Battle stage a. Even/odd uses the die's numeric value (Obliterate = 4, so even).

cards.name: Jingwa Psi Avenger
cards.text: With Psionic win, Opponent discards one Power card of their choice from hand.
cards.implementation: DiscardPowerFromHand: the opponent picks a Power card in hand and discards it (shown to everyone); with none, their hand is revealed.

cards.name: Shadow Assassin
cards.text: After Attackers & Defenders are set, roll red die. Result is X for Turn.
cards.implementation: X is rolled in Battle stage a (or when first needed this turn) and lasts until end of turn.

cards.name: Siana Commander
cards.text: All Attacking Creatures get +1 Psionic and +1 Physical.
cards.implementation: While in play and not trapped, every attacking Creature its owner controls (including itself) gets the bonus. Once per qualifying unit in a Stack; multiple Commanders add up.

cards.name: Therabot Seeker
cards.text: Roll red die. Result is X for Turn.

cards.name: Davileam Commander
cards.text: All Attacking Robots get +1 Cyber and +1 Physical.
cards.implementation: As Siana Commander, for Robots.

cards.name: Blade Master
cards.text: When Blade Master attacks, the attacked player's Lab takes 1 damage. If Blade Master destroys a Battle Unit, that unit's owner's Lab takes 1 damage.
cards.implementation: OnAttack -> DamageLab 1 to the attacked player; OnDestroyEnemyUnit -> DamageLab 1 to the destroyed unit's owner. Both can happen in one battle.

cards.name: Lodner Predator
cards.text: When Lodner Predator attacks, the attacked player destroys one of their Creation Units of their choice.
cards.implementation: OnAttack -> OpponentDestroysCU: the attacked player chooses one of their Creation Units (ready or depleted) and destroys it.

cards.name: Zomber Mercenary
cards.text: Roll red die. Result is X for Turn.

cards.name: Cyber Onslaught
cards.text: +1 Cyber for Robots or Cyborgs

cards.name: Vegian Cyber Shield
cards.text: +2 for Robots or Cyborgs

cards.name: Psi Bolster
cards.text: +1 Psionic for Creatures or Cyborgs

cards.name: Mental Shield
cards.text: +2 for Creatures or Cyborgs

cards.name: Physical Augmentation
cards.text: Add +1 to Physical

cards.name: Kranthard Armour
cards.text: +2 for any Battle Unit

cards.name: Creature Regenerate
cards.text: Return a destroyed Creature or Cyborg from your discard pile to play. A Creature returns with +1 Physical and -1 Psionic; a Cyborg with +2 Physical, -1 Cyber and -1 Psionic.
cards.implementation: ReviveToLab: choose a matching unit in your discard pile; it enters your Lab ready, with lasting modifiers by unit type (cleared if it leaves play).

cards.name: Equipment Hunter
cards.text: Search Deck for Equipment card. Place in Hand. Shuffle Deck. Discard Equipment Hunter.
cards.implementation: Search your Battle Deck for an Equipment card of your choice; put it in hand; shuffle (shuffle even if none found).

cards.name: Equipment Mechanic
cards.text: Pay any 1. Place one destroyed Equipment card back into your hand. Discard Equipment Mechanic.
cards.implementation: Choose an Equipment card from your discard pile; put it into your hand. Not playable if none.

cards.name: High-Energy Pulse
cards.text: ALL Units with Digital Abilities cannot Attack or Defend for Turn. Discard.
cards.implementation: Until end of turn, every Battle Unit (all players) with Cyber >= 1 or X Cyber cannot attack or defend. In Battle step 3 such units are removed from the battle. A stack is affected if either unit qualifies.

cards.name: Grankor Stasis Field
cards.text: TRAP BATTLE UNIT. Cannot Engage in Battle. At end of Player's every Turn, Roll Red Die. Battle Unit Freed if Physical Strength + Red Roll > 5.
cards.implementation: Q&A #7: an instant — playable on any opposing unit at any time. Escape test once per turn in the trapped unit owner's Cleanup: Physical (base + equipment; X/modifiers not applied, X counts as 0) + red die numeric value > 5 frees it; freed unit returns depleted.

cards.name: Creation Oracle
cards.text: Search Resource Deck for Creation Unit of Your Choice. Place in Lab. Shuffle Deck.
cards.implementation: When drawn: keep in hand for a later Creation phase, or discard it now to search. Using it from hand later does the same at no cost.

cards.name: Warend Reaper
cards.text: May Roll Red Die: 3, 4 or [Obliterate] = +1, 1 or 2 = -1 Physical
cards.implementation: Side 5 is not mentioned on the card: no change.

cards.name: Pencar Inferno
cards.text: Roll Red die. Result is X for Turn

cards.name: Acorbeac Destroyer
cards.text: If Psionic win, you may search your Battle Deck for a Cyborg, reveal it and put it into your hand. Shuffle.
cards.implementation: TutorToHand: optional search; the chosen card is revealed and put into hand, then the deck is shuffled.

cards.name: Xardy Piercer
cards.text: May Roll Red Die: 3, 4 or [Obliterate] = +1, 1 or 2 = -1 Physical
cards.implementation: The spec's 'Xaboy Piercer' (demo code: cost G1 P1). Printed card is 'Xardy Piercer' (file '26_Xardy Beast.psd') with cost G1 P1 W1 — printed card used.

cards.name: Resource Fortification
cards.text: Attach to one of your Creation Units in play. If this Creation Unit would be destroyed to pay for a Battle card, deplete it instead.
cards.implementation: Goes to hand when drawn; played free in your Creation phase onto one of your Creation Units (one per unit). When paying a destroy cost, fortified units are used first and depleted instead; it is discarded if its unit leaves play.

cards.name: Overload Strike
cards.text: Pay 1 Bio-Acceleration or Material Animation, and destroy 1. Deal 3 damage to any target (a Battle Unit or a Lab).
cards.implementation: DealDamage: target any Battle Unit in play or any player's Lab. A unit dies if the damage is at least its Physical strength, otherwise its Physical drops by that much until the end of the turn.
